description: This file defines the EagerOperationBuilder class, which implements the OperationBuilder interface for constructing eager execution mode operations in TensorFlow Java API.

classes.name: EagerOperationBuilder.NativeReference
classes.description: A nested class that manages the native operation handle, ensuring proper cleanup and deletion.

methods.name: EagerOperationBuilder.allocate
methods.description: Allocates a new native operation handle in the TensorFlow native environment.

methods.name: EagerOperationBuilder.delete
methods.description: Deletes the native operation handle to free resources.

methods.name: EagerOperationBuilder.execute
methods.description: Executes the operation and returns the tensor handles associated with the operation.

methods.name: addInput
methods.description: Adds an input tensor to the operation being built.

methods.name: addInputList
methods.description: Adds a list of tensors as inputs to the operation.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Sets the device on which to execute the operation.

methods.name: setAttr
methods.description: Sets various attribute types on the operation, including string, int, float, boolean, DataType, Tensor, and Shape.
